scripts.build: bun build src/content.ts --outfile=dist/content.js && bun build src/background.ts --outfile=dist/background.js && cp ./manifest.json ./hints.css ./dist/ && cp -r ./icons ./dist/
scripts.build:firefox: rm -rf dist-firefox && mkdir -p dist-firefox && bun build src/content.ts --outfile=dist-firefox/content.js && bun build src/background.ts --outfile=dist-firefox/background.js && cp ./manifest.firefox.json ./hints.css dist-firefox/manifest.json && cp -r ./icons ./dist-firefox/
scripts.release: bun run build && (cd dist && zip -r ../vifhint-$(bun -e 'console.log(require("./manifest.json").version)')-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD).zip .)
scripts.fix:staged: sh -c 'test -n "$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR)" && git diff --cached --name-only -z --diff-filter=ACMR | xargs -0 biome check --write && git diff --cached --name-only -z --diff-filter=ACMR | xargs -0 biome format --write && git diff --cached --name-only -z --diff-filter=ACMR | xargs -0 git add --'
scripts.check:staged: sh -c 'test -n "$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR)" && git diff --cached --name-only -z --diff-filter=ACMR | xargs -0 biome check'
scripts.ci: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run build
